name: Test record
meaning: The test record's ID.

name: State
meaning: The test record's state in the spec at the commit.

name: Result
meaning: Its result at the commit; none when no verified proof run exists there.

name: Last passed at
meaning: The newest commit a verified proof run passed it at, when any.

name: Record digest
meaning: The build record checked against.

name: Matches
meaning: Whether every digest matched.

name: Mismatches
meaning: Each input or output whose digest differs.

name: Image digest
meaning: The image checked.

name: Matches
meaning: Whether the image, its record and its build agree.

name: Signature acceptable
meaning: Whether the pinned workflow signed it.

name: Mismatches
meaning: Each part that does not agree.

name: Rule
meaning: The rule the fault breaks, by its name.

name: Path
meaning: Where in the declaration the fault is.

name: Found
meaning: What the declaration holds there.

name: Allowed values
meaning: The values the rule allows there, when it states a set.

name: Message
meaning: The fault in a sentence for a person, rendered from the fields above.
example: collection todos names an entity the declaration does not declare

name: Checkout
meaning: The checkout the record was read from.

name: Service name
meaning: The service the record describes, when a record was read.

name: Component
meaning: A component the service pins.

name: Version
meaning: The version of the component the service holds.

name: Digest
meaning: The digest of the component the service holds.

name: Record status
meaning: recorded when a record was read; unknown when the checkout holds generated output and no record, or a record that cannot be read.

name: Component
meaning: The pinned component.

name: Pinned digest
meaning: The digest the service pins.

name: Standing
meaning: current, superseded, withdrawn, or unchecked when the lifecycle records cannot be read.

name: Successor digest
meaning: The successor, when the pin is superseded.

name: Fails after
meaning: The date after which the pin fails, when it is superseded or withdrawn.

name: Needs declaration change
meaning: Whether taking the successor needs a declaration change.

name: Needs fill change
meaning: Whether taking the successor needs a fill change.

name: Past its fail date
meaning: Whether the fail date has passed, so validate fails and apply writes nothing.

name: Version
meaning: The compiler's version.

name: Build
meaning: The compiler's build identity.

name: Requirement
meaning: The requirement's kind and name.

name: Status
meaning: One of met, missing or wrong type.

name: Detail
meaning: What is missing or wrong, such as a secret key.

name: Fill name
meaning: The fill.

name: Collection
meaning: The collection it serves.

name: Standing
meaning: Its qualification standing.

name: Fill name
meaning: The bound fill.

name: Standing
meaning: Its qualification standing.

name: Fits binding
meaning: Whether it implements the bound slot for the bound collection.

name: Reason
meaning: Why it is not qualified or does not fit, such as the file that changed after its evidence.
example: policy.go changed after the tests passed

name: Path
meaning: The generated file or recorded input that differs.

name: Change
meaning: modified or deleted for a generated file; input changed for a recorded input.

name: Record status
meaning: sound, or broken when the record disagrees with itself or with the state it names.

name: Path
meaning: A generated file.

name: Action
meaning: generate, update, delete or unchanged.

name: Archetype
meaning: The archetype whose active component set the row describes.

name: Component
meaning: A component of the active component set.

name: Component version
meaning: The version the component declares.

name: Setting
meaning: A setting the component's schema declares, by its path.

name: Setting type
meaning: The type the setting's value must have.

name: Allowed values
meaning: The values checking accepts for the setting, when the schema states a set.

name: Optional
meaning: Whether a declaration may leave the setting out.

name: Default
meaning: The value used when the declaration leaves the setting out.

name: Slot
meaning: A slot the component or a mixin of the archetype declares.

name: Slot contract
meaning: The protobuf contract a fill for the slot implements.

name: Component
meaning: The component.

name: Version
meaning: The version the component declares.

name: Stage
meaning: The component's maturity stage.

name: Provided ports
meaning: The ports the component provides.

name: Required ports
meaning: The ports the component requires.

name: Slots
meaning: The slots the component offers.

name: Namespace
meaning: The output path the component writes into.

name: Component
meaning: The component.

name: Version
meaning: The version the service was built from.

name: Stage
meaning: The component's maturity stage now.

name: Sunset
meaning: The date the component stops working, if it is not ga.

name: Service
meaning: A recorded service built from the component.

name: Accepted until
meaning: The date the service's declaration accepts the component until, if it is not ga.

name: Past sunset
meaning: Whether the component is past its sunset.
